subject: POC environment dependencies & ownership — draft MAP and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Wu <danielle.wu@stellarmed.com>; Michael Lopez <michael.lopez@stellarmed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC environment dependencies & ownership — draft MAP and next steps

Hi Danielle / Michael —

Thanks again for the thoughtful call this morning. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC environment milestones we discussed. The goal here is to make responsibilities and dependencies explicit so we can hit your target evaluation window without surprises.

Top-level ask: please review the attached map (redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx) and confirm owners for the items below by EOD Friday (Nov 20). Once we have owners, we’ll schedule a 30-min runbook review with your infra team.

Quick summary (POC infra milestone subset):
- VPC peering: target = peering established & routes verified (owner: StellarMed network) — dependency: Peering request + CIDR confirmation from you.
- IP allowlists / firewall: target = outward allowlist applied (owner: StellarMed security) — dependency: Redwood egress IPs (attached firewall_allowlist_v1.txt) and test window.
- SSO / SAML: target = SAML connection + test user (owner: StellarMed SSO admin) — dependency: IdP metadata URL and a test account.
- Secrets / KMS: target = service account + KMS key & rotation policy (owner: StellarMed ops) — dependency: KMS key policies and role binding for redwood-service-sa.
- Service accounts & least-privilege roles: target = service account created before POC (owner: Redwood for template, StellarMed for creation).
- Audit/log collection: target = logs forwarded to your Splunk/Cloud logging (owner: StellarMed security) — please confirm retention requirements.

Proposed timeline: we’re proposing a 3-week run to deploy infra readiness starting after peering is complete. Target POC start: Dec 7, 2026. Target close (POC decision): Dec 18, 2026. We can compress if your team can prioritize peering + SSO in the next week.

Attachments included: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), firewall_allowlist_v1.txt (Redwood egress ranges).

Next steps:
1) Review owners & dependencies — please reply with owners and any procurement gating items.
2) Confirm a 30-min runbook review slot — we’re proposing Thu 11/19 at 10:00am PT.
3) If you need a written security/compliance binder (SOC2 summary + data flow), we can provide that as part of the runbook packet.

Thanks — looking forward to locking owners and getting this scheduled.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Danielle Wu <danielle.wu@stellarmed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Lopez <michael.lopez@stellarmed.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC environment dependencies & ownership — draft MAP and next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap and the MAP draft. I copied Mike (network lead / security) — he’ll be the day-to-day for peering + firewall. A few quick items from our side:

- Peering: we can open a peering ticket but need your confirmed egress ranges + ASN. I’ll ask NetEng to allocate a maintenance window — earliest available is Sat 11/21 (overnight).
- Firewall allowlist: Mike flagged that we need an explicit CIDR list (rather than hostname ranges) for our change request. The firewall team also wants to see test IPs for a 1-hour connectivity test.
- SSO / SAML: we use Okta. I can share metadata but need to confirm whether Redwood needs SP-initiated or IdP-initiated config. Is there a metadata endpoint or certificate file we should expect?
- KMS / secrets: our security policy requires customer-managed keys for production, but for POC we can stand up a scoped key in our project. We’ll need role names and the principal to grant (service account email).
- Compliance packet: yes please — SOC2 summary + data flow doc would be helpful for internal approvals.

Procurement note: we have a standard SOW process; procurement will want a short milestone-based SOW before we spin up dedicated infra. Is it possible to get a short SOW / scope-of-work for the POC (1–2 pages) tied to the MAP?

I’ll confirm owners by EOD and sync with Mike on the test window.

Thanks,
Danielle
Director, Product & Partnerships | StellarMed Inc.
D: +1 206-555-0413

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Wu <danielle.wu@stellarmed.com>
Cc: Michael Lopez <michael.lopez@stellarmed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC environment dependencies & ownership — draft MAP and next steps

Danielle — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping Mike. Below is an updated, action-oriented breakdown we’ll use to land owners and dates. I’ve pasted the short milestone list here to make it easy for procurement and NetEng to reference. I’ll update the attached MAP file after Mike confirms the peering window.

Milestones (owners, dependencies, and target dates):

1) Peering request submitted (owner: StellarMed - NetEng) — dependency: Redwood egress CIDRs + ASN. Target: submit by 11/19; completion target (peer + route verification) 11/22 if overnight window OK.
2) Firewall allowlist / test window (owner: StellarMed - Security; Redwood test lead: Ben Carter) — dependency: firewall_allowlist_v1.txt & 1-hour test IP. Target: 11/22 (test), 11/23 (finalize rules).
3) SSO / SAML integration (owner: StellarMed - Okta admin) — dependency: IdP metadata URL and a test user. Request: please confirm SP vs IdP initiated by 11/19. Target: config + smoke test by 11/25.
4) Service account & KMS key (owner: StellarMed ops for creation; Redwood will provide service account template and principal) — dependency: role binding names and principal email (we recommend redwood-service-sa@redwood-poc.iam.gserviceaccount.com). Target: 11/26 (ready for POC).
5) Audit/log forwarding & retention (owner: StellarMed security) — dependency: retention policy number (days) and destination. Target: 11/30.
6) Runbook review & SOC2 packet (owner: Redwood) — deliverables: 30-min runbook review, SOC2 summary doc, POC SOW (1–2 pages). Target: runbook 11/19; docs delivered by 11/20.

Ben — I’ve assigned you as Redwood test lead for the firewall test and will loop you into scheduling once Mike confirms. Karthik — can you own the SOC2/packet + short SOW? I owe you the template and will share the draft today.

Danielle — I’ll hold the proposed POC start date at Dec 7 but we can slide earlier if peering + SSO complete sooner. If procurement needs the milestone SOW sooner, tell me the internal procurement SLA and I’ll prioritize.

Attachments: I reattached firewall_allowlist_v1.txt and uploaded the current MAP draft to the shared Drive link.

Thanks — I’ll book Thu 11/19 10:00am PT for the runbook review and send a calendar invite; please let us know if that conflict exists.

—
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC environment dependencies & ownership — draft MAP and next steps

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the breakdown and for taking point. Mike confirmed the nightly window on Sat 11/21 between 11:00pm–2:00am PT for peering and a 1-hour connectivity test on 11/22 at 02:00am PT. I’ve uploaded our local network contacts list — see poc-network-contacts.csv.

Owners confirmed:
- Peering & firewall changes: Michael Lopez (NetEng)
- SSO / SAML: Claire Huang (Okta admin) — Claire will send metadata by EOD 11/19.
- KMS / secrets: Priya Patel (Cloud Ops) — Priya will provision a scoped key and share the principal.
- Procurement / SOW: I’ll own procurement coordination and will review the SOW draft when you send it.

We accept the MAP as a working draft. Please send the SOC2 summary and short SOW; procurement SLA is 5 business days for an initial review. Once the peering test completes, we’ll expect a short connectivity verification note from Redwood (Ben).

Looking forward to the runbook review at 11/19 10:00am PT.

Best,
Danielle

Attachments: poc-network-contacts.csv
